P1.1.text: Transforming how the world treats pain – Pacira BioSciences

P1.2.text: Better is possible. Join us in reimagining pain management with innovative, non-opioid therapies for chronic, postsurgical and musculoskeletal pain.

P1.4.text: More than 18 million patients have been treated with Pacira non-opioid therapies. We are building on that foundation every day.

P1.5.text: Our goal is to expand treatment options and partner across healthcare to make non-opioid therapies the standard, not the exception.

P1.6.text: Our commercial portfolio spans postsurgical, chronic, and musculoskeletal pain. Our pipeline includes a gene therapy candidate for knee osteoarthritis.

P1.7.text: Pain affects every part of life. We help patients understand their options and advocate for non-opioid care with their providers.

P1.8.text: Pacira was built on the belief that patients deserve better options. Our team works across science, education and advocacy to make that real.

P1.10.text: Our commercial therapies address postsurgical, chronic, and musculoskeletal pain.

P1.11.text: Our investigational pipeline includes PCRX-201, a gene therapy candidate for knee osteoarthritis, and is poised to transform how we approach osteoarthritis treatment with the goal of helping patients return to normal function.

P1.12.text: We remain committed to advancing therapies backed by rigorous, peer-reviewed clinical evidence.

P1.13.text: Better conversations lead to better care. We equip patients and caregivers with the resources to explore non-opioid options and partner with their providers on a plan built around them.

P1.14.text: Partnering to advance access, education, and advocacy

P1.15.text: Expanding access to non-opioid options requires working across the full healthcare system, with providers, policymakers, and patient advocates. We are committed to continuing that progress.

P1.16.text: Join us in making a difference

P1.17.text: Our teams are united by a passion for excellence and a commitment to patients.

P2.1.text: A leader in innovative pain management – About Pacira

P2.2.text: Our mission is to deliver innovative, non-opioid pain therapies to transform the lives of patients. Learn how we put our mission into action.

P2.3.text: Leading the future of pain management

P2.4.text: Pacira is shaping the future of pain management — with a portfolio of two commercial non-opioid therapies, an active pipeline, and a mission that extends well beyond the clinic.

P2.5.text: Our mission is to deliver innovative, non-opioid pain therapies to transform the lives of patients.

P2.6.text: Keep the patient at the center

P2.7.text: Pain is deeply personal, often overwhelming even the simplest daily tasks. Every decision we make is grounded in the needs and experiences of our patients.

P2.8.text: Science is the foundation upon which we build our innovations, ensuring safety, efficacy, and meaningful outcomes.

P2.10.text: How we do anything is how we do everything

P2.11.text: Our ONE Pacira culture is the fabric that unites our team’s passion for excellence and the patients we serve.

P2.12.text: Every day we are determined to achieve the extraordinary

P2.13.text: Guided by our commitment to keep the patient at the center, we recognize that every day matters for a patient suffering in pain.

P2.14.text: Integrity is the foundation of who we are

P2.15.text: We believe in transparency, accountability, and honesty, and we have the fortitude to make difficult decisions for the greater good.

P2.16.text: We respect diverse talent and the collective power of a unified team

P2.17.text: We recognize the role of teamwork toward tackling challenges, and we believe in the value of different experiences and perspectives.

P2.19.text: Guided by science, driven by integrity, and united by one purpose: to help reduce the impact of pain on people’s lives. Because better care isn’t optional — it’s essential.

P2.21.text: We pursue innovation with integrity — turning data into hope and science into access. Our breakthroughs don’t just relieve pain; they restore possibility. Our goal is to set a new standard of care,
